research.base_energistics.title: Thaumic Energistics
research.base_energistics.stage.1:
As both a scientist and an arcane scholar, I have postulated that it must be possible to combine technology and magic in a stable and productive way.
I should study the principles of matter-energy conversion in detail to accomplish this. It is likely there are aspects of thaumaturgy that can accomplish this, as well as technology capable of doing the same.
This will require extensive study, but I am sure that it will be a worthwhile investment of my time.
research.digisentia.title: Digi-Sentia
research.digisentia.stage.1:
Having discovered how to distill essentia, it occurs to me that I may be able to store it digitally.
Examining the §lFormation Core§r and §lAnnihilation Core§r I realize that with some minor modifications they could serve as a means to convert essentia to and from a digital format.
However, due to the corrosive nature of certain types of essentia, a layer of quicksilver around the circuitry is required to prevent decay.
research.digisentia.stage.2:
§lDiffusion Core§r
The relatively high volatility and immense energy in distilled essentia requires that it first be diffused and then digitized. A buffer chamber will likely be required to hold the diffused essentia.§lCoalescence Core§r
Compresses and binds re-materialized diffuse essentia back into its raw form. A buffer chamber will also likely be needed.
research.essentiastorage1k.title: Digisentia Storage
research.essentiastorage1k.stage.1:
Upon inspecting existing digital storage mediums I have concluded that I can in fact store digitized essentia.
By infusing §lCertus Quartz§r with §lSalis Mundus§r, it should gain the ability to store essentia, which remains remarkably active even in digital form.
I theorize that the higher the concentration of §lSalis Mundus§r, the more it should be able to store, although there are inherent limits to the quartz itself.
research.essentiastorage1k.stage.2: I have managed to create a storage device capable of storing a small amount of essentia digitally. Perhaps I can combine multiple components for increased storage?
research.essentiastorage4k.title: Bigger Digisentia Storage
research.essentiastorage4k.stage.1: Perhaps I can use different processing components to combine several storage components together.
research.essentiastorage4k.stage.2: I can now store a decent amount of essentia digitally by using calculation processors to allow the components to work together.
research.essentiastorage16k.title: Larger Digisentia Storage
research.essentiastorage16k.stage.1: As before, I can use higher-end processors to combine multiple storage components into a larger one.
research.essentiastorage16k.stage.2: Using a more advanced processor, I can now store sixteen times as much essentia as my crude first storage system.
research.essentiastorage64k.title: Massive Digisentia Storage
research.essentiastorage64k.stage.1: My current storage is no longer enough. I hope I can still combine components into something larger without increasing their physical size...
research.essentiastorage64k.stage.2: I can now store massive amounts of essentia on a single component, but I suspect this is the practical limit of this technology.
research.essentiabuses.title: Digisentia Transportation
research.essentiabuses.stage.1: Now that I can safely transport essentia through my ME system, I can adapt the network's automation buses to handle it directly.
research.essentiabuses.stage.2: Import, Export and Storage Buses can now work with essentia. Their behavior mirrors their normal AE2 counterparts while using Thaumcraft's essentia transport endpoints.
